title: Resident: the disk operating system and the episode loader

exclude: runtime: zero page, the OS's and the episodes' variables

runtime: the OS's window table ($0200), icon table ($0300) and window flags ($0400), its copy of zero page ($0413-$0511) and of the KERNAL's page 3 ($0600), and the disk code it copies to $0700 from disk_save ($F056)

left by the boot after the episode loader: fragments of a machine-code monitor (a register display at $099E calls $C0AB, where nothing of the kind is loaded) and, from $0B00, the tail of the GAME file; nothing the game runs reads them
runtime: the pointer's sprite shapes ($0B80), screen memory ($0C00), which holds the bitmap's colours, and the sprite pointers ($0FF8)
runtime: the bitmap the OS draws at $2000, and at $1000 the first boot stage's leftovers, which each episode overwrites
runtime: the start of the area where windows 8-14 keep what they cover
